evidence.detail: PR #6171 added a PDM card-page URL (<url>) to single_card_text_internal output for both price and non-price modes
Reverted 9a5a5f5b the same day: 'Feedback was that the link takes up too much space, especially in mobile'
Current single_card_text_internal builds text with name/mana/type/legality but no PDM link or decks/record/win% data
The !history command does append a PDM card URL, showing it is technically feasible — the rejection was UX-driven, not technical

triage.notes: The decision needed is: what format should win-rate/deck-count be presented in now that a raw URL was deemed too wide on mobile? Options include an embed field, a compact inline stat, or linking only when explicitly requested via a slash-command flag.
